{{Quote|Nok Drayen was the greatest gangster who ever lived. He personally wiped out the Rath Cartel and the Vandelhelm Combine during the Syndicate Wars.|[[Risha Drayen]], Nok Drayen's daughter|<ref name="Race">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|Race the Devil|Coruscant}}</ref>}}
The '''Rath Cartel''' was a criminal organization active at the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Affiliated with the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], the Rath Cartel was in the business of [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] weapons and hired [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] in their efforts to compete with the rival [[Vandelhelm Combine]] in a clash that later became known as the [[Syndicate Wars]].<ref name="Codex" />

However,<ref name="Codex" /> sometime between [[3667 BBY]] and [[3661 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> the fighting spilled over into a trade corridor controlled by the notorious [[Gangster/Legends|gangster]] [[Nok Drayen]], who quickly retaliated against both groups in order to protect his profits. Drayen called in favors from [[Gank/Legends|Gank]] mercenaries, [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]], and officials from the Sith Empire to destroy both gangs in reprisal. The Syndicate Wars ended when Drayen stormed the Combine's headquarters while simultaneously having the [[Rath Cartel leader|leader]] of the Rath Cartel [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]], and in the aftermath Drayen took all of the groups' profits for himself.<ref name="Codex" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The Rath Cartel was first mentioned the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Race" />
